CourseDetails.Heading: Importance of RHCVA
SubPoints: The Red Hat Certified Virtualization Administrator (RHCVA) certification is the first ever released Red Hat® certification in the field of Linux virtualization.
RHCVA-certified professionals can create and manage multiple virtual machines on a single system, significantly reducing hardware costs.
This training empowers learners to implement enterprise-grade virtualization using Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM) technology.
It is highly suitable for enterprises looking to consolidate systems and improve efficiency through virtual environments.
Provides strong foundational knowledge of virtualization tools, VM deployment, configuration, and maintenance using Red Hat technologies.
Ideal for IT professionals seeking to grow into cloud, virtualization, or data center roles.

CourseDetails.Heading: Importance of PHP
SubPoints: Designing and development are essential components of modern web applications.
PHP is a general-purpose, server-side scripting language widely used for website and web application development.
It is designed to create dynamic and interactive web pages and web-based software.
PHP scripts can run on a web server and are compatible with almost all major operating systems and web servers.
It supports integration with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and more, making it perfect for building data-driven applications.
Being open-source and easy to learn, PHP is preferred by beginners as well as professional developers.
It plays a major role in CMS platforms (like WordPress, Joomla), eCommerce (Magento), and frameworks (Laravel, CodeIgniter).

Prerequisites.P: Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

CourseDetails.Heading: Importance of AngularJS
SubPoints: AngularJS is widely used to build highly robust and scalable Single Page Applications (SPA).
It is built in JavaScript and uses HTML as a template language, making it easy to develop dynamic web content.
AngularJS provides two-way data binding and dependency injection, reducing boilerplate code significantly.
Developers can easily build client-side web applications with modularity, testability, and maintainability.
It assembles rich and interactive web applications that deliver seamless user experiences.
AngularJS is one of the most admired and in-demand frameworks in the web development industry.
Its MVC architecture and reusable components make it a preferred choice for scalable frontend development.

Prerequisites.P: Basic computer and internet knowledge.
No technical background is required.

CourseDetails.Heading: Importance of Digital Marketing
SubPoints: Digital marketing has become an essential part of modern business strategy across all industries.
It involves leveraging online platforms like websites, search engines, social media, and email to reach and engage customers.
Unlike traditional marketing, digital marketing is more measurable, targeted, and cost-effective.
It empowers businesses to reach global audiences, personalize messages, and track performance in real-time.
Digital marketing includes a wide range of elements: SEO, PPC, content marketing, social media, email campaigns, and web analytics.
Professionals trained in digital marketing are in high demand across startups, agencies, and large enterprises.
Learning digital marketing opens doors to careers in branding, growth hacking, performance marketing, and more.
